All other contexts use the deterministic ordering directly. 1. **Build the attacker:** establish Abra and Dunsparce lines, evolve through Kadabra / Rare Candy, then attach Psychic energy to Alakazam. 2. **Convert hand to damage:** `Powerful Hand` deals 20 damage per hand card, so the policy tracks immediate and attainable hand size before choosing a target. 3. **Preserve the draw engine:** Dudunsparce, Hilda, Dawn, Poké Pad, Night Stretcher, and recovery are used only when they retain a legal route to the next attacker. 4. **Disrupt precisely:** Enhanced Hammer handles visible special-energy defenses; Xerosic trims an opponent's large hand; Neutralization Zone is prioritized against visible ex pressure. 5. **Stay robust:** the entrypoint has a legal minimum-choice fallback.
